dataInfo.sql: SELECT C.NAME AS CATEGORY, COUNT(DISTINCT O.ORDER_ID) AS ORDERS, SUM(L.QUANTITY*L.UNIT_PRICE*(1-L.DISCOUNT/100.0)) AS SALES FROM ORDER_LINES L JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_ID = L.ORDER_ID JOIN PRODUCTS P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = L.PRODUCT_ID JOIN CATEGORIES C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = P.CATEGORY_ID WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', O.ORDER_DATE) AS INTEGER) = :FIRST_YEAR GROUP BY C.NAME ORDER BY C.NAME
